name: PT Wulandari Bangun Laksana Tbk
summary: PT Wulandari Bangun Laksana Tbk engages in the real estate business in Indonesia. The company operates through Developer, Pentacity Mall, E-walk Mall, Estate Management, and Other segments. Its Developer segment is involved in the sale apartment units, condotels, and shop houses and rental of malls, hotels, and office spaces. The Pentacity Mall segment provides management services in the Pentacity mall area of Balikpapan. Its E-walk Mall segment offers management services in the Balikpapan E-walk mall area.
